name: 草莓植株 1
prompt:
Standalone fruiting strawberry plant with bright natural green serrated leaves, multiple vivid ripe red strawberries, a few pale green unripe berries, white flowers with yellow centers and a dark soil root clump. Cheerful realistic farm colors, not pastel or monochrome. Tag foliage as secondary and berries, flowers and soil as primary. No ground or background. Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or n
Coordinate contract: local Y+ is up, local Z+ is the front, entrance, or forward direction, and local X+ is right. Put doors, facades, openings, windshields, noses, seats, and other recognizable front details toward local Z+. For a modular repeated element, explicitly choose the long axis: side-by-side modules span local X with depth/front on local Z; traversal modules span local Z. Keep the model centered at its origin.
Canonical dimensions contract: width=0.9, height=0.55, depth=0.9 world units. Keep the generated mesh within this centered bounding size.
